results.claim: Constant-power storage conserves bus energy, applies efficiencies once, and reports reserve/unserved demand onset.
results.scope: Implementation of specified piecewise-constant model only; W, Wh, h (1 Wh=3600 J); analytic epochs independent; no coordinate frame.
results.referenceVersion: NASA Power live page archived 2026-11-15 for subsystem scope; closed-form dimensional/conservation references audit-resources-reference-1.
results.inputIdentity: reference.json energy cases; input-identities.json lib/mission.ts SHA-256 at baseline 96079ae.
results.method: Five independently specified closed-form cases, per-segment bus conservation, plus two-second and lossy round-trip tests.
results.tolerance: 1e-9 Wh/h, model event offsets 1e-12 h; floating point acceptance only.
results.reproduce: npx tsx --test tests/audit-resources.test.ts tests/mission.test.ts tests/mission-events.test.ts tests/dsn.test.ts tests/station-weather.test.ts tests/engineering-evidence.test.ts
limitations: Synthetic closed-form inputs verify implementation, not physical battery performance. Reserve is a warning threshold, not load shedding.

results.claim: Fixed-array cosine incidence and uniform local disk fraction match independent vector/area integration.
results.scope: Local ENU east/north/up, azimuth clockwise from north, tilt from upward normal; degrees, W, W/m², m²; stationary analytic forcing.
results.referenceVersion: NASA Power archived 2026-11-15 for technology context; independent ENU and midpoint disk quadrature, 100000 chords.
results.inputIdentity: reference.json solar cases; input-identities.json baseline mission SHA-256.
results.method: Unit-vector dot products and numerical chord quadrature differ from implementation trigonometric expansion and circular-segment formula. Half disk yields half irradiance for a whole interval.
results.tolerance: 0.001 W fixed before comparison to allow quadrature discretization.
results.reproduce: npx tsx --test tests/audit-resources.test.ts tests/mission.test.ts tests/mission-events.test.ts tests/dsn.test.ts tests/station-weather.test.ts tests/engineering-evidence.test.ts
limitations: Uniform brightness/straight horizon cut/centre incidence only; no full solar-disk terrain convolution, limb darkening or tracking hardware dynamics.

results.claim: One-way free-space RF budget uses consistent SI, dBW, dBi, power dB and Eb/N0 conventions.
results.scope: GHz→Hz, km→m, W, K, bit/s; received dBW and Eb/N0/margin dB. Far-field vacuum scalar link, epoch/frame independent.
results.inputIdentity: reference.json three RF inputs; exact c=299792458 m/s and k=1.380649e-23 J/K.
results.method: Python linear EIRP flux density × receive effective aperture; energy per bit divided by kT; logarithms only at comparison outputs. Doubling invariants test SI/dB factors.
results.tolerance: 1e-10 dB roundoff tolerance; not an engineering margin.
results.reproduce: npx tsx --test tests/audit-resources.test.ts tests/mission.test.ts tests/mission-events.test.ts tests/dsn.test.ts tests/station-weather.test.ts tests/engineering-evidence.test.ts
limitations: Synthetic gain/noise/pointing/loss/coding/rate values are not qualified vehicle or DSN hardware. No measured radio link tested.

results.claim: Fresh station Horizons results agree with separately computed retained CSPICE station reference.
results.scope: 75 samples: three stations, hourly inclusive 2026-11-14T00:00:00Z..2026-11-15T00:00:00Z; Moon 301 / Earth coord@399; ITRF93 airless apparent AZ/EL degrees, range km.

results.inputIdentity: sources/*-fresh-horizons.json and manifest URLs/hashes; baseline public/data/engineering-evidence/spice-reference.json hash pinned in input-identities.json; its four kernel hashes retained.
results.method: Parse fresh provider bytes at 25 hourly epochs/station, wrapped azimuth differences and direct elevation/range differences against retained CSPICE ENU results.
results.tolerance: 0.002 deg AZ/EL, 0.1 km range; original cross-kernel implementation check thresholds; neither temporal nor physical truth bounds.
results.reproduce: npx tsx --test tests/audit-resources.test.ts tests/mission.test.ts tests/mission-events.test.ts tests/dsn.test.ts tests/station-weather.test.ts tests/engineering-evidence.test.ts
